content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Vacancy 2026 - 9 Posts
content_sections.text: Vacancy Note: The advertised numbers are indicative. NIT Puducherry reserves the right to fill, modify or leave vacant any advertised position according to institutional requirements and applicable rules.

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Teaching Recruitment 2026 - 6 Vacancies
content_sections.text: Important: The five Assistant Professor vacancies are listed collectively across seven departments. The notification does not allocate one vacancy to each of these departments.

rows.departments: Civil Engineering; Electrical and Electronics Engineering; Computer Science and Engineering; Electronics and Communication Engineering; Mechanical Engineering; Chemistry; Humanities and Social Sciences

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The faculty vacancy document specifies department-wise academic qualifications and specializations. Candidates must possess the relevant degrees and a Ph.D. in the prescribed discipline. The minimum academic requirement includes First Class in preceding degrees, equivalent to at least 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale or 60% aggregate marks . Candidates who obtained a Ph.D. directly after B.Tech. are also eligible, provided they secured First Class in their Bachelor's degree. Applicants must also meet the applicable NIT faculty recruitment rules, including teaching/research experience, academic credentials and other selection conditions for the respective faculty level.

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026 - 3 Vacancies
content_sections.text: Department Allocation: The Technical Assistant position is earmarked for the Civil Engineering Department, while the Technician position is earmarked for the Mechanical Engineering Department.

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The three documents covered in this article provide the common recruitment announcement, six teaching vacancies and three non-teaching direct recruitment vacancies. Official Recruitment Documents: View NIT Puducherry Recruitment Notifications NIT Puducherry Non-Teaching Group A & B Notification PDF NIT Puducherry Non-Teaching Group B & C Notification PDF NIT Puducherry Teaching Notification PDF The Opportunities page also provides separate faculty general instructions, non-teaching recruitment rules, reservation certificate formats and other supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026 Eligibility
content_sections.text: The institute states that essential qualifications, desirable qualifications, experience and age limits for non-teaching recruitment will follow the Recruitment Rules, 2019 for Non-Teaching Staff in National Institutes of Technology , notified through the relevant Ministry of Human Resource Development communications dated 20 February 2019 and 4 April 2019. Applicants must satisfy the post-specific conditions prescribed in those rules as on 12 December 2026. The Technical Assistant vacancy is earmarked for the Civil Engineering Department under Group B, Pay Level 6. Candidates should check the Technical Assistant recruitment rules linked on the official NIT Puducherry Opportunities page before applying. The Pharmacist vacancy is a Group C position carrying Pay Level 5. The institute follows the prescribed NIT non-teaching recruitment rules for its essential academic and professional requirements. Important: Desirable qualifications should not be confused with essential eligibility. Candidates must refer to the official Pharmacist recruitment rules to verify the required Pharmacy qualification and other eligibility conditions. The Technician vacancy is a Group C position under Pay Level 3 and is earmarked for the Mechanical Engineering Department. Applicants must satisfy the relevant technical, trade and other eligibility requirements prescribed under the NIT Non-Teaching Recruitment Rules, 2019.

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: For non-teaching recruitment, the institute specifies that the maximum age limit shall be as prescribed under the applicable Non-Teaching Recruitment Rules. Age and Eligibility Calculation Date: 12 December 2026 for the three non-teaching positions. The teaching vacancy document does not provide a complete post-wise age schedule. Candidates applying for faculty positions must follow the relevant NIT faculty statutes and general instructions. Important: SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against Unreserved vacancies are not entitled to category-based age relaxation for those UR positions. Applicants claiming age relaxation must possess valid supporting certificates in the prescribed Government of India format.

rows.age_relaxation: Eligible Defence Service Period Plus 3 Years, Subject to Applicable Rules

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The advertised teaching and non-teaching positions carry different pay levels under the 7th Central Pay Commission. The applicable basic pay, allowances, deductions and service benefits will be governed by the pay matrix and relevant NIT regulations. Salary Clarification: The AGP references in the teaching notification identify academic grades and should not be represented as additional monthly salaries. The advertised pay levels do not by themselves establish the exact take-home salary.

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment Mode: Online through the non-teaching application portal. Candidates applying for more than one non-teaching post must submit separate applications and pay the applicable fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The institute will screen applications according to essential qualifications, applicable recruitment rules, reservation and prescribed selection standards. For faculty posts, candidates will be assessed under the applicable NIT faculty statutes and academic recruitment criteria. The detailed stages, including shortlisting and any interview or other assessment, will be governed by the official faculty recruitment general instructions. Online application submission. Scrutiny of eligibility and supporting documents. Shortlisting by the Screening Committee, where required. One or more selection stages determined by the institute. Verification of original qualifications and reservation certificates. Final selection according to the applicable recruitment rules. The institute may restrict the number of candidates called for selection and conduct a multi-stage process. Important: The supplied non-teaching notification does not prescribe a complete written examination pattern, question distribution or examination date. The selection scheme will be published separately with the list of provisionally eligible candidates.

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: NIT Puducherry has provided a dedicated SAMARTH portal for direct recruitment to the three non-teaching positions. Non-Teaching Direct Apply Link: NIT Puducherry SAMARTH Recruitment Portal Non-Teaching Last Date: 12 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Faculty Recruitment Instructions: NIT Puducherry Opportunities Page

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Puducherry Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates must not send hard copies of non-teaching applications or documents to the institute at the application stage. Shortlisted candidates will be required to produce their online-generated application form, original documents and one set of self-attested copies during verification. Candidates should not assume that the non-teaching SAMARTH portal or its 12 December deadline applies to faculty recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NIT Puducherry Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The following documents may be required according to the selected post and recruitment stage: Class 10 or Class 12 certificate for date-of-birth verification. Relevant graduation and postgraduate certificates. Engineering or technical qualification certificates, where applicable. Ph.D. degree certificate for teaching positions. Academic marksheets and CGPA conversion records, where applicable. Research and teaching experience documents for faculty posts, where prescribed. Professional or technical qualification documents for non-teaching posts. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate, where applicable. PwD certificate issued by the competent medical board, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen certificate, where applicable. Recent photograph and other portal-required uploads. No Objection Certificate for Government, PSU or other applicable employees. Online-generated application form. Original certificates and self-attested copies during document verification. For non-teaching recruitment, OBC-NCL candidates must possess the prescribed Central Government-format certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026 . EWS candidates must possess an Income and Assets Certificate for financial year 2025-26, issued on or after 1 April 2026 in the prescribed Central Government format. Failure to produce the required category certificate may result in the candidate being considered under the Unreserved category, subject to meeting UR eligibility.

content_sections.heading: NIT Puducherry Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026 Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online through SAMARTH. The closing date is 12 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. No hard-copy application is required at the application stage. Separate applications and fees are required for multiple posts. Incomplete applications will be rejected. Qualifications and other eligibility conditions are assessed as on 12 December 2026. The Screening Committee may shortlist candidates. The selection process may involve multiple stages. Original certificates must be produced for document verification. Candidates employed by Government, autonomous bodies, PSUs or similar organizations must provide the applicable NOC. No travel or daily allowance will be paid for attending selection stages. Selected candidates will be on probation for one year, subject to satisfactory completion and applicable rules. Selected employees may be posted or transferred between institute departments. Vacancy numbers are indicative and may be changed. Recruitment updates will be published on the institute's official website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in NIT Puducherry Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The two supplied direct recruitment advertisements together list 12 vacancies, including six teaching and three non-teaching posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIT Puducherry Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The non-teaching online application deadline is 12 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Faculty applicants must check the separate teaching recruitment instructions for their deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for these posts?
faq.answer: There is one Associate Professor vacancy in Mathematics and five Assistant Professor Grade-I vacancies across the departments listed in the teaching advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. How many non-teaching vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 6 non-teaching vacancies

faq.question: Q5. What is the NIT Puducherry non-teaching application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500 for General/UR, OBC-NCL and EWS candidates. SC/ST/PwD/female/transgender candidates are exempt.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NIT Puducherry teaching posts?
faq.answer: Associate Professor carries Pay Level 13A2, while Assistant Professor Grade-I carries Pay Level 12 under the 7th CPC academic pay matrix.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an age relaxation for non-teaching recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. The notification specifies five years for SC/ST, three years for OBC-NCL and additional relaxation for eligible PwD and Ex-Servicemen candidates under applicable rules.

faq.question: Q8. Is hard-copy submission required for non-teaching applications?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must apply online through SAMARTH and should not send hard copies at the application stage.

faq.question: Q9. Can an NIT Puducherry Ph.D. holder apply?
faq.answer: Not unless there is three years of outside experience after leaving the Institute. Candidates who obtained their Ph.D. from NIT Puducherry are otherwise not considered.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the selection process?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending any stage of the selection process.
